about.label: About
about.heading: Software that's solid underneath and effortless on the surface.
about.body: I'm ASURA — a full-stack developer from Mongolia, finishing my Computer Science degree (2021–2026). Coding started as coursework and quietly became the thing I'd pick over anything else.
about.body2: I focus on web and app development, building products end to end — from interface to infrastructure. I'm especially into machine learning and deep learning for financial markets, and I've also built embedded systems.
about.education: New Mongol College of Technology — Computer Science (2021–2026)
about.focus: Web & app development · ML/DL for finance

work.label: Selected Work
work.heading: A few things I've built.
work.note: Selected projects across web, apps, and applied ML.

projects.name: Dropshipping Platform
projects.description: An end-to-end commerce platform for Mongolia: four apps (user web & mobile, driver, admin) sharing one design system, with automated customs, currency, and delivery calculations.
projects.highlight: 4 apps · one shared design system · SSR / SEO

projects.name: Portfolio Optimization
projects.description: Reinforcement-learning agents for portfolio allocation with leak-free temporal splits and a reward shaped by return, cost, and drawdown.

projects.name: MT5 Trading Bot
projects.description: A rule-based research system with regime detection (ADX / CHOP / ATR), look-ahead-bias-free multi-timeframe logic, and walk-forward validation.

projects.name: Lucentia
projects.description: A deterministic, server-authoritative real-time engine — focused on anti-cheat, economy, and data modeling. A study in backend and systems design.

lab.body: A space for things that don't fit a brief — shaders, 3D, and interaction studies. This site itself is one of them: built with React Three Fiber, GSAP, and Lenis.
